At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Machine Learning expert, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational STEM problems that simulate real scientific workflows.
  • Create problems that require Python programming to solve.
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks).
  • Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains and creative problem-solving approaches.
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard libraries (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn).
  • Document problem statements clearly and provide verified correct answers.

How to get started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Master’s or PhD Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or a similar STEM field.
  • You have at least 5 years ofMachine Learning experience with proven business impact.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (numpy, pandas, scipy, sklearn).
  • Solid understanding of numerical methods and computational algorithms.
  • Research or industry experience involving computational problem-solving.
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $58/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

raw.description:
Why work at NebiusNebius is leading a new era in cloud computing to serve the global AI economy. We create the tools and resources our customers need to solve real-world challenges and transform industries, without massive infrastructure costs or the need to build large in-house AI/ML teams. Our employees work at the cutting edge of AI cloud infrastructure alongside some of the most experienced and innovative leaders and engineers in the field.

Where we workHeadquartered in Amsterdam and listed on Nasdaq, Nebius has a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, North America, and Israel. The team of over 800 employees includes more than 400 highly skilled engineers with deep expertise across hardware and software engineering, as well as an in-house AI R&D team.

The role

We are seeking a Senior Network Security Architect to join our Network team. This position combines deep expertise in network engineering and cybersecurity, with a focus on designing secure, scalable, and resilient architectures for enterprise and data center environments.

You will be responsible for developing end-to-end network security designs for complex backbone and fabric infrastructures, ensuring alignment with corporate security standards, and driving design reviews in collaboration with the Security and Infrastructure teams.

The role requires hands-on expertise with next-generation firewalls, a deep understanding of routing and switching, and the ability to influence architecture direction across multiple technical domains.

You will also mentor engineers, lead design sessions, and contribute to defining the future of secure network connectivity across on-prem and cloud platforms.

You’re welcome to work in our office in Amsterdam, The Netherlands or Remote within the EU

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design secure architectures for enterprise office networks, VPN, and remote access solutions.
  • Architect and validate data center fabric/backbone and WAN security designs at scale.
  • Lead firewall architecture and policy design across platforms such as Palo Alto and Check Point.
  • Define and maintain segmentation models, internet edge, DMZ, and Zero Trust network patterns.
  • Perform threat modeling and risk assessments for network and connectivity solutions.
  • Ensure network security designs align with industry standards and compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST).
  • Implement automation for configuration, policy deployment, monitoring, and compliance validation using Python, Go, or equivalent tools.
  • Collaborate closely with Security, Platform, and Cloud teams to ensure secure integration across environments.
  • Lead incident resolution efforts, perform root cause analysis, and guide the team through complex troubleshooting.
  • Prepare and present architecture documents for technical and executive review.
  • Act as a senior technical mentor and contribute to defining long-term network security strategy.

We expect you to have:

  • Proven expertise in networking (TCP/IP, routing protocols, switching) and security architecture.
  • Experience designing and securing enterprise, data center, or cloud network infrastructures.
  • Hands-on proficiency with next-generation firewalls (Palo Alto, Check Point, or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with network automation and scripting in Python, Go, or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of Unix/Linux systems and major network vendors (Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, etc.).
  • Ability to independently design and document complex architectures with clarity.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with experience influencing across teams.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Working knowledge of IPv6 and modern routing protocols.
  • Experience with automation and infrastructure-as-code tools (Ansible, Terraform, NetBox, SaltStack, etc.).
  • Background in large-scale, high-availability distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles, micro-segmentation, and SASE/SD-WAN architectures.
  • Knowledge of identity-based networking and integration with IAM/IdP systems.
  • Experience with network visibility and analytics (e.g., Splunk, Zeek, NetFlow).
  • Relevant certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, PCNSE, CCSE, or CISSP.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within Nebius.

About Portless

Portless is redefining global fulfillment for fast-growing DTC brands. We enable merchants to ship direct-from-factory with Amazon-level speed, reliability, and transparency—without the traditional complexity of cross-border logistics. Our customers are some of the most innovative consumer brands in the world, and they expect a world-class experience across onboarding, integrations, fulfillment, tracking, exceptions, and support.

As VP of Product, you will own the end-to-end customer journey and build the digital and operational engines that power Portless’s next stage of hypergrowth.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a strategic yet deeply operational product leader who thrives in the messy reality of complex, real-world systems. You will:

  • Unify product, data, operations, engineering, and customer success into a cohesive roadmap.
  • Build a user experience that feels inevitable to fast-growing eCommerce brands: intuitive onboarding, seamless integrations, proactive visibility, and flawless fulfillment.
  • Bring clarity, structure, and scale to a hybrid business where digital interfaces, warehouse operations, global carriers, and internal teams all must work in lockstep.

If you love translating ambiguity into elegant systems — and have experience with tech-enabled logistics (e.g., rideshare, food/grocery delivery, freight, last-mile, marketplace ops) — you will thrive here.

What You’ll Own

1. Product Strategy & Vision

  • Define and own the multi-year product roadmap aligned to company strategy and merchant needs.
  • Build a vision for a frictionless, end-to-end merchant experience—from contract → integration → inbounding → fulfillment → tracking → exception handling.
  • Combine operational reality with ambitious customer experiences to create a category-defining product.

2. Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead and grow the Product and Design team.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering, Operations, Customer Support, and Sales/Partnerships.
  • Create product processes that scale: requirements, prioritization, discovery loops, beta programs, and feedback systems.

3. Customer Experience & Merchant Success

  • Own the quality of the merchant journey end-to-end, including onboarding, integrations, workflows, and visibility.
  • Translate high-touch customer expectations (DTC brands doing $100k+ monthly) into scalable product and support systems.
  • Develop world-class merchant dashboards, exception workflows, and tools for proactive visibility.

4. Operational Excellence & Tooling

  • Build and refine internal tools for Operations, CX, and Partner teams—ensuring our people are as empowered as our customers.
  • Understand warehouse, cross-border, and carrier operations well enough to design systems that improve reliability, SLAs, and efficiency.
  • Drive automation in exception handling, carrier selection, tracking, and compliance.

5. Data, Insights, and Quality

  • Establish metrics and KPIs that measure reliability, customer experience, operational efficiency, and product adoption.
  • Partner with Data to instrument the platform for real-time visibility.
  • Build a culture of measurement and hypothesis-driven iteration.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • 7–10+ years of product leadership, with at least 3+ years in tech-enabled operations, logistics, or marketplace environments

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: WATCH HERE

Why Work with Us?

At Pearl, we're not just another recruiting firm—we connect you with exceptional opportunities to work alongside visionary US and EU founders. Our focus is on placing you in roles where you can grow, be challenged, and build long-term, meaningful careers.

Role Overview

The UI/UX Designer creates intuitive, user-centered digital experiences that balance usability, aesthetics, and business goals. This role spans the full design lifecycle—from research and wireframing to high-fidelity UI design and prototyping—across web platforms, SaaS products, mobile applications, and marketing experiences.

You will work closely with product, engineering, and marketing teams to translate user needs into clear, effective interfaces. This role is ideal for designers who enjoy solving problems through thoughtful design, value research-informed decisions, and thrive in collaborative, fast-paced environments.

Your Impact

Your designs improve how users interact with digital products by reducing friction and increasing clarity. Through well-structured flows and polished interfaces, you help improve usability, engagement, and conversion outcomes. Your work supports scalable product growth while ensuring consistent and accessible user experiences.

Core Responsibilities

User Research & Analysis — 20%

  • Conduct user research and usability testing
  • Analyze user behavior and identify experience gaps
  • Create personas, user journeys, and flow diagrams
  • Translate research insights into actionable design solutions

Wireframing & Prototyping — 25%

  • Create low- to high-fidelity wireframes
  • Build interactive prototypes to demonstrate user flows
  • Design responsive layouts across devices
  • Iterate designs based on feedback and testing results

Visual UI Design — 30%

  • Design polished, pixel-perfect interfaces aligned with brand guidelines
  • Apply strong visual hierarchy, typography, and layout principles
  • Create reusable UI components and patterns
  • Design conversion-focused landing pages and product interfaces

Design Systems & Component Libraries — 15%

  • Build and maintain scalable design systems
  • Create and document reusable components and patterns
  • Ensure consistency across products and platforms
  • Collaborate with developers on design system implementation

Usability Testing & Optimization — 5%

  • Plan and execute usability testing sessions
  • Analyze findings and iterate on designs
  • Optimize user flows based on data and feedback

Collaboration & Communication — 5%

  • Partner with product managers and developers
  • Present design concepts and rationale to stakeholders
  • Participate in reviews, planning sessions, and critiques

Requirements

Must-Haves (Required)

  • 1–2+ years of UI/UX design experience
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end design process
  • Proficiency in Figma for wireframing, prototyping, and UI design
  • Solid understanding of UX principles and interaction design
  • Strong visual design fundamentals (layout, typography, hierarchy)
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

  • User research or usability testing experience
  • Conversion-focused or CRO design exposure
  • Experience designing SaaS, mobile apps, or dashboards
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG)
  • Basic understanding of front-end constraints (HTML/CSS concepts)

Tools Proficiency

Must-Haves (Required)

  • Figma (components, auto layout, prototyping)
  • Wireframing and prototyping tools
  • Strong visual design and layout fundamentals

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

  • Adobe XD or Sketch
  • Prototyping tools (Framer, Principle, ProtoPie)
  • User testing tools (Maze, UserTesting, Hotjar)
  • Collaboration tools (FigJam, Miro)
  • Project management tools (Notion, Jira, Asana)

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote — work from anywhere
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Direct Mentorship: Access to global industry leaders
  • Learning & Development: Continuous growth resources
  • Global Networking: Work with international teams
  • Health Coverage (Philippines only): HMO after 3 months (full-time)

Build a long-term remote career designing meaningful digital experiences for global teams. Join Pearl Talent and grow as a designer through ownership, collaboration, and continuous learning.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare).
  • Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn).
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks).
  • Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction.
  • Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility.
  • Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations).
  • Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches.
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods.
  • Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.

How to get started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Master’s or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
  • You have at least 5 years ofhands-on data science experience with proven business impact.
  • You have portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem-solving.
  • You are proficient in python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels).
  • You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.
  • You are proficient in SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis.
  • You have experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases).
  • You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows.
  • You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain).
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $34/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

You will guide clients through the technical direction of their SFMC environments and help them design, build, and optimize their digital messaging programs across email, mobile, and other engagement channels.

In this role, you’ll work directly with clients as a trusted technical advisor. You’ll help identify opportunities, recommend scalable solutions, and deliver hands-on development. You’ll partner closely with email developers, strategists, analytics teams, account managers, and project managers to ensure every solution is thoughtful, reliable, and impactful.

You will report to the Technical Manager and works closely with developers, project managers, strategists, and client stakeholders. This role offers a growth path into Senior Platform Architect and leadership positions within the team.

What You’ll Do

Technical Architecture & Platform Support

  • Design and support end-to-end SFMC Engagement architecture for assigned clients

  • Translate client requirements into clear, scalable technical solutions

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Troubleshoot platform issues and escalate when needed

  • Stay current on SFMC releases and ecosystem updates to improve client solutions

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in at least two SFMC languages (AMPscript, SSJS, SQL, GTL)

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Data Science AI Trainer, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

Although every project is unique, you might typically:

  • Design original computational data science problems that simulate real-world analytical workflows across industries (telecom, finance, government, e-commerce, healthcare).
  • Create problems requiring Python programming to solve (using pandas, numpy, scipy, sklearn, statsmodels, matplotlib, seaborn).
  • Ensure problems are computationally intensive and cannot be solved manually within reasonable timeframes (days/weeks).
  • Develop problems requiring non-trivial reasoning chains in data processing, statistical analysis, feature engineering, predictive modeling, and insight extraction.
  • Create deterministic problems with reproducible answers: avoid stochastic elements or require fixed random seeds for exact reproducibility.
  • Base problems on real business challenges: customer analytics, risk assessment, fraud detection, forecasting, optimization, and operational efficiency.
  • Design end-to-end problems spanning the complete data science pipeline (data ingestion → cleaning → EDA → modeling → validation → deployment considerations).
  • Incorporate big data processing scenarios requiring scalable computational approaches.
  • Verify solutions using Python with standard data science libraries and statistical methods.
  • Document problem statements clearly with realistic business contexts and provide verified correct answers.

How to get started
Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. From creating training prompts to refining model responses, you’ll help shape the future of AI while ensuring technology benefits everyone.

Requirements

  • You hold a Master’s or PhD Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related quantitative field.
  • You have at least 5 years ofhands-on data science experience with proven business impact.
  • You have portfolio of completed projects and publications showcasing real-world problem-solving.
  • You are proficient in python programming for data science (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels).
  • You are an expert in statistical analysis and machine learning with deep understanding of algorithms, methods, and their practical applications.
  • You are proficient in SQL and database operations for data manipulation and analysis.
  • You have experience with GenAI technologies (LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, vector databases).
  • You have good understanding of MLOps practices and model deployment workflows.
  • You possess knowledge of modern frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain).
  • Your level of English is advanced (C1) or above.
  • You are ready to learn new methods, able to switch between tasks and topics quickly and sometimes work with challenging, complex guidelines.
  • Our freelance role is fully remote so, you just need a laptop, internet connection, time available and enthusiasm to take on a challenge.

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $55/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Take part in a part-time, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments.
  • Work on advanced AI projects and gain valuable experience that enhances your portfolio.
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise.

raw.title: Product Intern
raw.excerpt: About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
raw.description:
About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Product Intern who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

In this role, you’ll help validate new product features, flag bugs before they cause headaches, and contribute directly to making our product experience seamless and delightful across platforms. You’ll work cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and engineers to ensure every release is reliable and user-friendly. If you’re eager to see how product strategy, feature delivery, and quality assurance intersect at a high-growth fintech company—this one’s for you.

What You'll Do:

Internal Documentation & Runbooks

  • Create and maintain clear internal documentation and runbooks for orders and issuing flows (MID operations, card issuance, refunds, decline handling, support triage).
  • Produce playbooks for common incidents, release notes, and onboarding materials for new team members and cross-functional partners.

Quality Assurance & Feature Validation

  • Proactively test new features and integrations related to orders and issuing across web, mobile, and APIs; reproduce and document bugs, usability issues, and edge cases; validate issuing-specific scenarios (card creation, single-use vs multi-use behavior, authorizations, settlement, refunds).
  • Partner closely with engineering to create reliable test cases, acceptance criteria, and automated/manual test plans.

Monitoring & Anomaly Detection

  • Monitor dashboards and key operational metrics (approvals/declines, authorization errors, failed issuances, order processing time, refund behavior); build/redash dashboards and alerts; quickly flag and investigate anomalies.
  • Triage alerts into actionable incidents, assemble data for post-incident reviews, and recommend short- and long-term mitigations.

Support Ticket Analysis & User Feedback

  • Triage support tickets related to orders and issuing, identify recurring patterns, and surface priority issues to Product and Engineering.
  • Analyze qualitative user feedback and quantitative support trends to propose product improvements that reduce support load and improve customer experience.

Competitive & Market Analysis

  • Research issuing and payments competitors and fintech trends (virtual card features, controls, fraud controls, settlement models); synthesize findings into concise reports that inform prioritization and roadmap decisions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Special Projects

  • Participate in agile ceremonies, collaborate with Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and Support, and contribute to product ideation, wireframes, and testing scenarios.
  • Own ad-hoc projects such as A/B tests, process automation, or pilot features that advance the orders & issuing roadmap.

What We Look For:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Human-Computer Interaction, Economics, or a related field
  • 4.2 GPA or higher (required for consideration)
  • A genuine interest in product development, user experience, and the “why” behind product decisions
  • Strong attention to detail—you notice when something’s just a little off, and it bugs you until it’s fixed
  • Comfort digging into product experiences and identifying what’s working and what’s not
  • Analytical thinking and basic data skills (Excel/Sheets, with bonus points for SQL curiosity)
  • Effective written and verbal communication—you can explain a bug to a developer and feedback to a PM without playing translator
  • Familiarity with agile methodologies, product tools (Jira, Confluence, Figma, Mixpanel), or prototyping software is advantageous but not required—we value quick learners.
  • Prior experience in internships, projects, or extracurriculars related to product, QA, UX/UI, startups, or tech (e.g., hackathons, app development) is a plus.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Compensation: The salary for the Product Intern is 700 USD monthly gross.

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. Candidates we’ve hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

Why Work with Us?
At Pearl, we’re not just another recruiting firm—we connect you with exceptional opportunities to work alongside visionary US and EU founders. Our focus is on placing you in roles where you can grow, be challenged, and build long-term, meaningful careers.

Role Overview

The company is a growing therapy group providing speech therapy services to children and families. We collaborate closely with providers and caregivers to deliver coordinated care and maintain a supportive, patient-first experience.

As a Medical Billing Specialist, you will oversee the entire billing workflow, ensuring accurate insurance verification, efficient claim submission, and timely resolution of billing issues. You will act as a subject matter expert (SME) for billing workflows, coach team members, review their work for accuracy, and serve as the escalation point for complex payer and patient inquiries.

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable communicating with payers, families, and internal staff, and experienced in end-to-end medical billing operations with a demonstrated leadership background.

Your Impact:

Your leadership and accuracy will directly support the clinic’s mission of delivering uninterrupted, high-quality care. By managing your team effectively and resolving claims efficiently, you will ensure that both families and providers experience a transparent and stress-free financial process.

Core Responsibilities

Insurance Verification & Patient Cost Estimates – 50%

  • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits using Availity and payer portals.
  • Contact insurance companies for coverage clarification and policy details.
  • Generate accurate cost estimates for evaluations and ongoing care.
  • Communicate estimates to families clearly and empathetically.
  • Confirm in-network status and coordinate with credentialing as needed.

Authorizations & Referral Management – 20%

  • Submit prior authorization and referral requests for services requiring approval.
  • Track authorization limits, expirations, and visit usage for ongoing treatment.
  • Communicate authorization status updates with providers and administrative staff.
  • Resubmit authorizations or follow up on pending determinations to prevent service disruption.

Billing & Claims Processing – 25%

  • Enter and reconcile patient charges across two EMR systems.
  • Manage copays, co-insurance, and upfront evaluation payments.
  • Resolve claim errors that prevent submission and address payer denials.
  • Conduct denial research, correct claim issues, and resubmit as necessary.
  • Coordinate with clearinghouse and coding as needed and complete write-offs per policy.

Documentation Validation & Patient Communications – 5%

  • Confirm provider notes are submitted on time and meet billing documentation standards.
  • Serve as primary contact for patient billing questions via email/tickets.
  • Ensure responses are clear, empathetic, and consistent with billing policies.

Requirements

Must-Haves:

  • Strong knowledge of insurance verification, billing, and claim workflows.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and ownership mindset.
  • Comfortable in fast-paced, high-volume, and ambiguous environments.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with multiple EMR systems and clearinghouse software.
  • Knowledge of pediatric therapy billing procedures.
  • Experience training or mentoring new billing staff.

Tools Proficiency

Required:

  • Availity (insurance verification)
  • EMRs (ability to learn and manage multiple systems)
  • Payer portals and claims submission platforms
  • Email and ticket-based communication systems

Preferred:

  • Candid or similar billing systems
  • Clearinghouse claim management platforms

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Based on experience and skills
  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Performance Bonus: Based on data accuracy, reporting timeliness, and overall sales efficiency
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Health Coverage for PH-based talents: HMO coverage after 3 months for full-time employees

Reports to: Regional Director

Location: Seattle, WA

Company Overview:

Braeburn is dedicated to delivering solutions for people living with the serious consequences of opioid use disorder. At Braeburn, we challenge the status quo and champion transformation of the management of opioid use disorder (OUD) by partnering with the community to create a world where every person with OUD gets the best possible care and opportunity to reach their full potential. Our shared commitment to innovation on behalf of patients enables us to help people with OUD begin and sustain recovery.

At Braeburn, there are opportunities to contribute to our purpose every day. We value authenticity and strive to amplify all voices. Our culture empowers everyone to be successful and unleashes our full potential.

Position Summary:

The Key Account Manager will help Braeburn accomplish its purpose by educating Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) about Braeburn’s products and related access resources. This role will help to ensure HCPs are fully informed about the clinical aspects of the product as well as how to obtain the product when making an independent treatment decision for their patients.

Specifically, the Key Account Manager will meet their overall sales objectives by delivering clinical product-related information and providing access related information, in line with Company policies, to appropriate HCPs. The role will require the ability to deliver sales objectives as well as effectively educate on product acquisition, related payer policy, and reimbursement information.

The skills required for a Key Account Manager are Accountability, Adaptability, Business Acumen/Planning, Judgement and Collaboration, Problem Solving, Account Management, Sense of Urgency, Decision Making, and Integrity. Individual must possess experience within a complex distribution model including Specialty Pharmacy, Buy & Bill and direct distribution.

The Key Account Manager must conduct all work activities in accordance with Braeburn policies and code of conduct.

Specific Duties:

  • Achieveplanned Braeburn goals, and patient access to product objectives and other expected performance measures for assigned geography
  • Demonstrate mastery of sales competencies:
    • Business Acumen – Review, analyze and interpret reports / facts and data to plan and execute territory activities that ensure quarterly and annual objectives are met. Develop a deep understanding of assigned territory, including delivery of care, major payers and regulatory environment. Understand industry trends and emerging competition as well as reimbursement patterns and potential implications to patient delivery. Understand state law and policies to execute tactics within a local geography
    • Scientific Knowledge – Mastery of disease state and product information communicated in a compliant manner consistent with the FDA-approved product labeling and REMS program
    • Customer Engagement – Engage with account personnel to prepare for sales call, uncover needs and opportunities, communicate approved solutions, address customer concerns, gain advance/commitment, post call analysis/next steps
  • Using internally approved materials, provide information to help inform physicians and office personnel about access related information for Braeburn’s products
  • Effectively manage and support accounts, which includes ensuring product access and resolving/triage reimbursement issues in a manner that complies with Braeburn policies, processes, and procedures to optimize customer and patient experience
  • Collaborate effectively with all Braeburn cross-functional partners
  • Develop ongoing dialogue with customers to effectively anticipate and adapt to customers’ needs, as well as evolving market challenges and opportunities
  • Exercise sound judgment, and ensure integrity and compliance with all Braeburn policies and Braeburn Code of Conduct
  • Exercise fiscal control of operational expenses

Skills:

  • Drive for results/strong sense of accountability and ownership
  • Strong work ethic and commitment to excellence
  • Ability to build strong relationships and effectively inform HCPs about Braeburn’s products
  • Strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Ability to solve problems
  • Proven expertise in informing healthcare provider offices surrounding coding, billing, and submissions in range of payer environments
  • Strong Emotional Intelligence
  • Documented team-oriented collaboration skills
  • Strong ethical behavior and commitment to compliance
  • Demonstrated passion and empathy for improving Addiction/Mental Health patient care
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, accountable start-up environment

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree (BS/BA) required. Advanced business degree a plus
  • 7+ years of pharmaceutical experience with at least 3 years of sales and/or field market access experience in biotech/specialty pharmaceutical/device industries
  • Proven sales or field market access performance as evidenced by market performance reports and recognition awards in Specialty Pharmacy markets
  • In-depth understanding of reimbursement/insurance coverage for physician-administered treatments
  • Proven product launch experience in a highly complicated and competitive environment
  • Experience selling specialty products, in-particular physician-administered products such as implantable or injectable medication technologies in a healthcare setting
  • Ability to work autonomously to find new business opportunities
  • Valid driver’s license and in good standing
  • Experience in a start-up environment a plus
  • Willingness to travel both regionally and nationally. Some territories may require overnight travel up to 50-70%.

description: einleitung Als Infrastructure Operations Manager (m/w/d) bist du der fachliche Dreh- und Angelpunkt für die Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Nitrado Infrastruktur.

raw.title: Infrastructure Operations Manager (m/w/d)
raw.excerpt: einleitung Als Infrastructure Operations Manager (m/w/d) bist du der fachliche Dreh- und Angelpunkt für die Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Nitrado Infrastruktur.
raw.description:
einleitung

Als Infrastructure Operations Manager (m/w/d) bist du der fachliche Dreh- und Angelpunkt für die Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Nitrado Infrastruktur. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die fachliche Steuerung unserer Betriebsthemen. Du hast keine disziplinarische Personalverantwortung, übernimmst aber eine klare fachliche Lead-Rolle. Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit der Teams, treibst technische Themen voran und sorgst dafür, dass operative Anforderungen in den Roadmaps berücksichtigt werden.

Mit deiner starken technischen Basis und deiner Hands-on-Mentalität stellst du sicher, dass Betrieb, Wartungen und Incident-Prozesse über unseren gesamten On-Prem-Stack sauber funktionieren, von Netzwerk und Hardware über VM und Kubernetes-Plattformen bis hin zu zentralen Services, die unsere Entwicklerteams täglich brauchen.

deine aufgaben

Wartungen & Changes koordinieren: Du planst Wartungsfenster und stellst sicher, dass alle beteiligten Teams gut vorbereitet sind. Du koordinierst die Durchführung, behältst Risiken und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst für einen sauberen Abschluss inklusive nachvollziehbarer Dokumentation.
Incident Management: Bei kritischen oder größeren Incidents übernimmst du die Koordination. Du bringst die richtigen Stakeholder zusammen, hältst den Informationsfluss sauber und sorgst für eine schnelle Wiederherstellung. Danach treibst du die strukturierte Aufarbeitung inklusive Maßnahmenverfolgung voran.
Problem Management: Du stellst sicher, dass wiederkehrende Störungen nicht nur kurzfristig behandelt, sondern nachhaltig gelöst werden. Dafür sorgst du für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung.
Risk & Lifecycle Management: Du behältst die Stabilität unseres gesamten Stacks im Blick, von Patching und Upgrades bis hin zu technischen Schulden und EOL Themen. Du identifizierst Abhängigkeiten und Betriebsrisiken frühzeitig, machst sie transparent und schaffst damit die Grundlage für Priorisierung und Planung in den Roadmaps.
Etablierung von Betriebsstandards: Du entwickelst unsere Standards und Prozesse im Betrieb weiter, damit sie skalierbar, nachvollziehbar und reproduzierbar sind. Dazu gehören zum Beispiel; Runbooks, Checklisten, Eskalationswege und Abläufe für Wartungen und Incidents.
Fachliche Steuerung & Roadmaps: Du arbeitest eng mit den anderen Infrastrukturteams zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass Themen wie Stabilität, Kapazität und Lifecycle in den Roadmaps berücksichtigt werden. Du hältst operative Anforderungen präsent und bringst Themen bis zur Umsetzung.
Technischer Sparringspartner (Hands-on): Du bleibst nah an der Technik, unterstützt pragmatisch bei komplexen Analysen und verstehst unseren Stack im Detail. Du bist die Brücke zwischen operativer Realität und technischer Planung, ohne selbst im Tagesgeschäft der Tickets unterzugehen.

dein profil

Du bringst mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Infrastructure Operations oder im Platform-Umfeld mit, idealerweise in einer On-Prem oder Hybrid-Umgebung.
Du hast nachweisbare Erfahrung im Incident Management, in der Change und Maintenance Koordination sowie im nachhaltigen Problem Management.
Du bist technisch so fit, dass du über mehrere Layer hinweg auf Augenhöhe mitreden, beraten und priorisieren kannst, zum Beispiel in den Bereichen Netzwerk, Hardware, Plattformen und zentrale Services.
Du arbeitest strukturiert und zielorientiert, kannst Entscheidungen herbeiführen und komplexe Themen mit vielen Beteiligten zuverlässig zum Abschluss bringen.
Du kommunizierst klar, sachlich und ruhig - besonders in kritischen Incident Situationen.
Du hast einen hohen fachlichen Anspruch und willst Dinge inhaltlich gestalten. In dieser Rolle liegt dein Fokus auf dem Was und Wie unserer Infrastruktur, nicht auf disziplinarischer Führung. Du gibst fachlich Orientierung, prägst Roadmaps mit und führst Teams sicher durch komplexe operative Themen.

deine benefits

Gaming im Herzen: Wir bieten kostenlose Nitrado Game Server für Gamer und eine einladende Community für alle, die sich wohlfühlen möchten, selbst wenn du kein/e Gamer:in bist. Entdecke, wie Nitrado mehr ist als nur Gaming - eine offene Community für Technologie und Kreativität.
Vertrauensarbeitszeit: Passe deine Arbeitszeiten an deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse an, um eine bessere Work-Life-Balance zu erreichen.
Remote Work: Unsere agilen Teams arbeiten Hand in Hand von ihrem bevorzugten Standort aus zusammen, sei es in unseren modernen Büros in Karlsruhe oder Berlin oder vollständig remote.
Work from Abroad: Erweitere deinen Arbeitsbereich über die nationalen Grenzen hinaus mit unserer Remote-Work-Lösung aus dem Ausland. Wir ermöglichen es dir, zeitweise von deinem bevorzugten internationalen Standort aus zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig mit deinem Team in Kontakt zu bleiben.
Mentale Gesundheit: Wir unterstützen deine mentale Gesundheit durch unseren jährlichen Mental Health Day.
Physische Gesundheit: Unsere Büroinfrastruktur bietet modernste Arbeitsplätze mit ergonomischem Design, um deine Gesundheit und Produktivität zu fördern, während du auf dem Arbeitsweg mit deinem JobRad fit bleibst. Zusätzlich erhältst du einen großzügigen Zuschuss zu ergonomischen Home Office Möbeln, um auch von zu Hause aus optimal arbeiten zu können.
Weiterbildung: Nutze Fort- und Weiterbildungen, um Deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir unterstützen Deine finanzielle Sicherheit für die Zukunft mit einem attraktiven Zuschuss.
Arbeitsumfeld: Bei uns erlebst du ein respektvolles und freundliches Arbeitsumfeld, geprägt von Transparenz und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.
Urlaub und bezahlte Freizeit: Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub und bezahlten Sonderurlaub zu besonderen Anlässen.
Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Als internationales Unternehmen überwinden wir erfolgreich Zeitzonen und Sprachbarrieren und bieten dir eine internationale Arbeitsatmosphäre.
Soziale Aktivitäten: Stärke Dein Engagement und den Teamzusammenhalt durch Team-Building-Events, der Teilnahme an Sportevents und sozialen Aktivitäten.
Langjährige Stabilität: Mit über zwei Jahrzehnten Erfahrung sind wir ein verlässlicher Arbeitgeber für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.
Wohlbefinden am Arbeitsplatz: Genieße frische Küche und vielfältige Verpflegung, die dein leibliches Wohl sicherstellt.
Get together: Wer arbeitet, kann auch feiern - Wir kommen regelmäßig für unsere Firmenfeiern zusammen und stärken unsere Teambindung.
Firmenkultur und Werte: Du wirst Teil einer positiven Unternehmenskultur, die Werte wie Diversität und Inklusion lebt.

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. They're looking for the sharpest, hungriest candidates who they can consistently promote and work with over many years. Candidates we've hired have been flown out to the US and EU to work with their clients, and even promoted to roles that match folks onshore in the US.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for: WATCH HERE

Why Work with Us?

At Pearl, we're not just another recruiting firm—we connect you with exceptional opportunities to work alongside visionary US and EU founders. Our focus is on placing you in roles where you can grow, be challenged, and build long-term, meaningful careers.

Role Overview

The Patient Intake Specialist owns the front-end execution of healthcare intake workflows, ensuring patient records, documentation, and provider details are accurate, complete, and compliant before moving downstream.

This role is detail-intensive and process-driven, combining high-volume data management with proactive coordination across patients, providers, and internal teams. You’ll act as a critical operational checkpoint—protecting data integrity, ensuring HIPAA compliance, and preventing downstream delays that affect patient care and service delivery.

This role is ideal for healthcare operators who thrive in structured environments, excel at quality control, and take pride in precision, follow-through, and operational discipline.

Your Impact

Your work will directly improve patient experience, turnaround time, and operational efficiency. By ensuring intake data is accurate from the start, you’ll reduce rework, prevent compliance issues, and support timely care coordination. Your attention to detail and proactive issue resolution will strengthen healthcare delivery while maintaining the highest standards of data security and documentation quality.

Core Responsibilities

Data Management & Quality Control — 35%

  • Perform high-volume data entry and management of patient records and healthcare datasets
  • Ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency across intake systems
  • Review incoming forms and documentation for errors or missing information
  • Create clean, accurate base records prior to downstream processing
  • Conduct detailed QA checks against provider-specific requirements
  • Verify patient demographics, insurance details, and medical histories
  • Maintain EHR and database hygiene through cleanup and deduplication
  • Monitor workflows to proactively identify discrepancies or risks

Provider Research & Coordination — 25%

  • Identify all providers and facilities involved in patient care
  • Research billing providers, networks, and healthcare entities
  • Verify provider credentials, participation, and submission requirements
  • Document and maintain accurate provider records in internal systems
  • Navigate provider portals and healthcare databases efficiently
  • Coordinate directly with providers to resolve missing or unclear information
  • Track non-standard provider requirements and escalate when needed

Intake Processing & Request Management — 20%

  • Process patient intake requests and Release of Information (ROI) forms
  • Build complete, submission-ready documentation packets
  • Assign requests based on workload, priority, and specialization
  • Ensure clean handoffs to downstream teams with complete context
  • Track intake requests through defined stages and SLAs
  • Manage scheduling data and maintain updated patient/provider records
  • Handle volume spikes and priority shifts with accuracy and urgency

Compliance & Process Adherence — 10%

  • Maintain strict HIPAA compliance in all workflows
  • Follow SOPs for data handling, documentation, and communication
  • Identify compliance risks and escalate appropriately
  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and intake records
  • Conduct final compliance checks before submission
  • Stay current on healthcare regulations impacting intake operations

Communication & Escalation — 10%

  • Communicate intake status clearly with patients, providers, and internal teams
  • Resolve conflicting or missing information through coordinated follow-ups
  • Handle patient inquiries professionally and compassionately
  • Flag edge cases, blockers, or non-standard scenarios early
  • Maintain clear documentation of issues and resolutions
  • Provide regular updates to ensure stakeholder alignment

Requirements

Must-Haves (Required)

Experience

  • 1 - 2+ years in patient intake, healthcare data entry, medical records, or healthcare operations
  • Experience processing patient information or healthcare documentation at scale
  • Proven track record of maintaining high data accuracy

Healthcare Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of HIPAA and data confidentiality standards
  • Familiarity with medical terminology and healthcare documentation
  • Experience navigating provider networks and healthcare systems

Data & Systems

  • Exceptional attention to detail and QA discipline
  • Experience with EHR systems or healthcare databases
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills

Technical

  • Proficiency in Google Sheets / Excel
  • Strong PDF editing and document management skills
  • Ability to learn healthcare software quickly

Communication

  • Excellent written and verbal English
  • Professional, empathetic communication style
  • Confidence handling incomplete or ambiguous inputs

Work Style

  • Process-driven, compliance-oriented executor
  • Comfortable working independently in fast-paced environments
  • Reliable PST/EST working-hour overlap

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

  • 3+ years in healthcare intake or patient coordination
  • U.S. healthcare system exposure
  • Experience with ROI workflows
  • Familiarity with Chartswap, Availity, or similar portals
  • Experience with scheduling platforms (ClearCare, AlayaCare, AxisCare)
  • Medical billing, coding, or insurance verification exposure
  • Healthcare process improvement experience

Tools Proficiency

Must-Haves (Required)

  • Adobe Acrobat and PDF management tools
  • Google Sheets / Excel (advanced)
  • EHR systems or healthcare databases
  • Email, Slack, Zoom
  • Google Workspace

Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

  • Provider portals (Chartswap, Availity)
  • EHRs (Epic, Cerner, Athenahealth)
  • Scheduling platforms (ClearCare, AlayaCare, AxisCare, WellSky)
  • CRM or case management systems
  • VoIP tools (OpenPhone, RingCentral, Klara)
  • Task tracking tools (Asana, Notion, Trello)

Benefits

  • Remote Work: Fully remote — work from anywhere
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy
  • Direct Mentorship: Access to global industry leaders
  • Learning & Development: Continuous growth resources
  • Global Networking: Work with international teams
  • Health Coverage (Philippines only): HMO after 3 months (full-time)

**Applicants for this position have the flexibility to work remotely from their home anywhere in the United States. Candidates must currently have either a Wisconsin RN license or a compact RN license. The work schedule is Monday - Friday, 8am - 5pm Central. Previous NICU and OB experience are strongly preferred.**

Position Purpose: Develops, assesses, and facilitates complex care management activities for primarily physical needs members to provide high quality, cost-effective healthcare outcomes including personalized care plans and education for members and their families.

  • Evaluates the needs of the member, barriers to accessing the appropriate care, social determinants of health needs, focusing on what the member identifies as priority and recommends and/or facilitates the plan for the best outcome

Mindrift is looking for highly skilled Vibecode specialists to join the Tendem project (https://tendem.ai/) and drive specialized data scraping workflows within our hybrid AI + human system.

In this role, as an AI Pilot – that’s how we refer to this role at Mindrift – you’ll collaborate with Tendem Agents that handle repetitive tasks, while you provide critical thinking, domain expertise, and quality control to deliver accurate and actionable results.

This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for technical professionals with hands-on experience in web scraping, data extraction and processing.

What we do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Vibe Code specialist, you'll handle data scraping tasks requiring technical precision for web extraction and processing, utilizing various tools such as our provided Apify and OpenRouter alongside your own resourceful approaches.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end data extraction workflows across complex websites, ensuring complete coverage, accuracy, and reliable delivery of structured datasets.
  • Leverage internal tools (Apify, OpenRouter) alongside custom workflows to accelerate data collection, validation, and task execution while meeting defined requirements.
  • Ensure reliable extraction from dynamic and interactive web sources, adapting approaches as needed to handle JavaScript-rendered content and changing site behavior.
  • Enforce data quality standards through validation checks, cross-source consistency controls, adherence to formatting specifications, and systematic verification prior to delivery.
  • Scale scraping operations for large datasets using efficient batching or parallelization, monitor failures, and maintain stability against minor site structure changes.

How to get started

Simply apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to projects that match your technical skills, on your own schedule. From coding and automation to fine-tuning AI outputs, you’ll play a key role in advancing AI capabilities and real-world applications.

Requirements

  • At least 1 year of relevant experience in data analysis, AI automation, data engineering, or software development is desirable.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related technical fields is a plus.
  • Python web scraping: Build reliable scraping scripts using BeautifulSoup, Selenium (or equivalents) for multi-level sites, dynamic JS content (infinite scroll, AJAX), and API endpoints via provided proxy.
  • Data extraction expertise: Navigate complex hierarchical structures (regions → companies → details), handling archived pages and varied HTML formats.
  • Data processing: Clean, normalize, and validate scraped data; deliver high-quality datasets in well-structured formats (CSV, JSON, Google Sheets) with clear, consistent presentation.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI frameworks to enhance automation and problem-solving.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
  • Self-directed work ethic with ability to troubleshoot independently.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required).

Benefits

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $30/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs.
  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Gain hands-on experience in a unique hybrid environment where human expertise and AI agents collaborate seamlessly — a distinctive skill set in a rapidly growing field.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive IT Vendor Management Program Manager to lead the execution of our third-party risk management framework. This role is the backbone of our vendor oversight, ensuring that every partnership—from non-critical services to complex bank integrations—aligns with our high standards for security, compliance, and operational excellence. You will have the authority to manage the vendor lifecycle and ensure our program remains robust under regulatory scrutiny.

Compensation

The compensation range for the role is $5,000 - $7,500 USD GROSS per month as a contractor. Specific compensation offered to a candidate may be dependent on factors such as education, experience, qualifications, and alignment with market data. Exceptional candidates may receive salaries outside of the posted ranges.

What You'll Do:

  • Standards & Governance: work cross-functionally with IT, Legal, and Compliance teams to establish and maintain third-party risk standards and governance practices.
  • Due Diligence & Monitoring: Conduct comprehensive vendor due diligence and ongoing monitoring activities, including evaluating consumer-impact risk, complaint analysis, and confirming privacy and data protection standards.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Manage third-party risk documentation and reporting, including maintaining the vendor and data processor inventory, ensuring timely onboarding and offboarding due diligence, and executing periodic compliance reviews.
  • Risk Assessment: Execute day-to-day risk assessments to determine vendor criticality and identify inherent risks in categories such as PII handling, BSA/AML, and credit decisioning.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with Legal to ensure effective contracts are in place and with Information Security to validate the technical safeguards of our third-party partners.
  • Issue Escalation: Identify, track, and escalate risk events or performance failures to senior leadership and bank partners through established issue-tracking systems.

What We Look For:

  • Experience: 7+ years of professional experience in vendor risk management, procurement, or third-party compliance, preferably within the fintech or regulated financial services industry.
  • Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of third-party risk management lifecycle and regulatory guidance (e.g., PCI-DSS, SOC 2, GLBA, and BSA/AML).
  • Execution: Proven track record of managing a high volume of vendor assessments and maintaining a state of "audit-readiness" for bank partners and regulators.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Law, or equivalent practical experience.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.
